home.hero_subtitle: ScamShield doesn't just tell you what's true or false. We guide you to ask the right questions, spot the warning signs, and navigate the digital world with confidence.
home.stat1_label: of users feel more confident online
home.how_subtitle: Our goal is to build your digital resilience through guided practice and community awareness.
home.feature1_desc: Submit suspicious links, emails, or text. Our AI highlights trust indicators and warning signs, then prompts you with questions to investigate further.
home.feature2_desc: Take bite-sized interactive lessons on phishing, deepfakes, and social engineering to recognize manipulation tactics before they work.
home.feature3_desc: Explore trending scams reported by others. See real-world examples of how attackers operate in your region right now.
home.trending_subtitle: What the community is reporting right now.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Real people across Ethiopia are using ScamShield to build confidence and spot manipulation with calm, critical thinking.
home.testimonials_quote_placeholder: Share how ScamShield helped you stay safe or think more clearly.
home.faq_subtitle: Learn more about how our platform works.
home.faq1_q: Is this an automated scam detector?
home.faq1_a: No. ScamShield is an educational tool. We do not make definitive judgments on your behalf. Instead, we highlight warning signs and trust indicators, and guide you through the verification process so you build your own critical thinking skills.
home.faq2_q: What happens to the content I verify?
home.faq2_a: Content submitted for verification is analyzed securely and temporarily stored for your personal dashboard. We strip personally identifiable information before analysis to protect your privacy.
home.faq3_a: Our lessons and quizzes are developed by media and information literacy experts, following guidelines set by international organizations like UNESCO.
